issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: bookshelf, lectern, candle, red_wall_banner, dark_oak_button.
1089 blocks, over the common budget of 350 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.
18 layers tall: builders reach 9 without scaffolding, which isn't verified in game yet.

notes.detail: Adds red banners on the tower front, lanterns under the arcade and in the hall roof (all hung from blocks above), bookshelves, a lectern, candle and button clock hands. The banners are the only addition visible at a glance; the market stalls read as a few barrels, a hay bale and a chest, so detail is at most 1 here.
notes.purpose: Banners and the records room make it read as a civic seat.
notes.depth: Same shell as L1; back face still flat.
notes.levels: Visibly different from L1 only by the two tower banners; the 'market stalls' new job does not read as stalls (no counters with goods, no awnings).

visual.summary: L2 adds the town's market and records: barrels, hay and a chest under the arcade, records shelves and a lectern in the hall, lanterns, red banners on the tower and clock hands.
problems: Market stalls under the arcade (barrels x4 z8-9, hay x8 z8, chest x8 z11, slab counter x4 z11-12, y1) read as storage, not stalls: give them counters facing the arches, goods on top and a small awning (e.g. wool/carpet or slab canopy) so L2's new job is visible from outside.
Clock hands are dark oak buttons on dark oak log ends (x6 y13 z0, x3/x9 y13 z3): invisible against the log; use a contrasting dial.
Reachability: same as L1 (hall, arcade, tower office and back stair reached; tower clock chamber at y10 x5..7 z2..4 unreached; bookshelf tops unreached: fine).
